collection.name: react-component-library-make-the-control-contract-real-baseline
collection.detail: Generation 4 re-anchor produced ready anchors for experience-manager and web-console. The react-component-library member failed evidence validation because Test Genie returned no phase result.

measurementNotes: The plan's prose expected 180 renderable source files; the measured current gate corpus is 177. No synthetic assets were added to reach the stale estimate.

The original pre-work collection was incomplete. Generation 4 is the current re-anchor; its two ready members are usable, while the RCL member failure remains recorded rather than treated as a passing baseline.
